spec.name: SG17 reliability-filtered second-pass additions
spec.track: training-free W class-word; frozen CA and SA module 15
spec.quantile_population: VOC-only native 64x64 pixels with raw y2-y1 > 0; one pixel has one vote
spec.quantile_ties: closest achievable nonempty upper-tail fraction on integer q_up counts; higher cutoff wins exact ties; actual fraction reported; no GT
spec.five_fold_source: configs/voc_sim_folds.csv; existing run_screen promotion and 4/5 vote guard
spec.candidate_normalization: each raw candidate map independently minmax-normalized at 64x64, bilinear to annotation size
spec.coco_policy: all cutoffs and mask thresholds frozen on VOC; transfer only
spec.densecrf_policy: run only if SG17 promoted; fixed existing OVAM SimpleCRF parameters; compare selected SG17+R2 with P1+R2
spec.selection: no extra cutoffs, per-class cutoffs, soft gates, COCO tuning or learned weights
